en: The image shows a black-and-white photograph of a landscaped park with a prominent statue or monument on a pedestal in the foreground. There are several people, including groups and individuals, standing or sitting on benches. In the background, a large building with a domed roof and ornate architectural features is partially visible through the trees. The scene appears to be from an earlier time period, possibly late 19th or early 20th century.
